systems.owner: Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship (DNRPC)
systems.tiers: district registration offices and hospital mortuaries of the national registration department; 81 of 116 districts, e-death notification in 24 named districts

note: Civil registration runs in the national department's district registration offices and in hospitals, not in council offices; local councils appear only as stakeholders to engage on burial-site deaths. No council office connection is stated.
